tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: The desk: the app background the sheet lies on, and the deepest step. The Sections rail sits on it with no fill. Light: papyrus, the warmest step. Text: `color-text`, `color-text-muted`, `color-accent-text`.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: One step above `color-bg`: the sheet in dark (`color-sheet`), and the bundle's InlineMessage, path bar and tree pane. In light it is a papyrus tint a step under the sheet.

tokens.name: color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: The note step: Dialog, Toast, menus, the one drawer, the MatureCover panel (`color-note`), and the sheet in light, the palest papyrus. Notes take `elevation-note`, not a border. Never the fill of a flat control on the sheet: it vanishes on the sheet in light (use `color-hover`).

tokens.name: color-sheet
tokens.usage: The sheet: one per screen, holding its main content, on the desk with `space-desk` around it, at `radius-sheet` with `elevation-sheet`. Ink lies flat on it; anything interactable sits on top of it (`color-object`).

tokens.name: color-note
tokens.usage: Notes on the sheet: the drawer, dialogs, menus, toasts, tooltips, popovers, Add a plugin, the plugins panel, a thread card. With `elevation-note` (tooltips `elevation-art`), no border.

tokens.name: color-object
tokens.usage: Anything interactable on top of the page: Card, a tile, an invite, a field (a slip), a dense list's piece (`.zf-tree`, `.zf-list`), the pill switch (`.zf-tabs`, `.zf-seg`) and its lifted option, a lifted row, a touched quiet button. With `elevation-art`, no border (a field keeps its edge). Light: the sheet's own papyrus, set apart by its warm shadow.

tokens.name: color-pile-top
tokens.usage: The top of a Pile that is a control, not art: "2 for later", the strangers' tray. With `elevation-art`, which sets it apart (in light it is the sheet's papyrus). `color-text` and `color-text-muted` hold 4.5:1 on it; a `color-border-strong` edge doesn't (2.8:1 in dark), so none sits on it. Dark: `color-text` mixed 10% into `color-surface-raised`, written out; redo it if either changes.

tokens.name: color-peek-into
tokens.usage: What a Pile's peeks fade into, `size-peek-step-dark` or `-light` more per peek, so the deeper ones recede. Never text.

tokens.name: color-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for the secondary Button and IconButton and path links, on any surface (rows, tabs and quiet buttons lift onto `color-object` instead); also the resting fill of a flat quiet control (no shadow of its own), of general and OC tag chips and of a typed tag chip. Text on it stays `color-text`.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panes, card outlines, dividers. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls a person must find: inputs, selects, checkboxes, the secondary button, the off Toggle, the query box. At least 3:1 on `color-bg`, `color-surface` and `color-surface-raised` in both skins (light: a warm grey on papyrus).

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Body and UI text on every surface, soft tint and status soft fill. Dark: Zuri's fur white; light: Zuri's coat.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, hints, handles, tree meta, hidden dotfiles. 4.5:1 or better on `color-bg`, the surfaces, `color-hover` and `color-selected`. Also the locked look.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Zuri's crown gold, as a fill: the primary button, a checked Checkbox or Toggle, the Pin. Sparingly: one primary action per view.

tokens.name: color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a primary button, and any icon or text on a `color-accent` fill (checked Checkbox tick, on Toggle thumb, the Pin number).

tokens.name: color-accent-text
tokens.usage: Gold as text or icon: links, the pill switch's selected option (Tabs), the open tree item's icon. On `color-bg`, the surfaces and `color-selected`.

tokens.name: color-selected
tokens.usage: The open tree item: the row whose contents fill the right pane; also the open list row, a pressed IconButton and the selected option of the pill switch (Tabs), which stays lifted with its text in `color-accent-text`. A gold tint. Never the only cue: the open item and the current section also take weight-semibold, a 2px inset color-accent-border ring and aria-current; the switch's option takes `weight-bold` and its lift.

tokens.name: color-accent-border
tokens.usage: Edge of the primary button. In light it is a deeper gold so the button still reads against white.

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1 or better on every surface it lands on, `color-selected` included.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive fills only: the Delete button. Never a person's state, never a deadline.

tokens.name: color-on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a `color-danger` fill.

tokens.name: color-danger-text
tokens.usage: System errors as text: a failed upload, a field the server rejected. On `color-bg`, the surfaces and `color-danger-soft`.

tokens.name: color-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error Toast and an error InlineMessage.

tokens.name: color-secondary-iris
tokens.usage: Zuri's eye blue, as text or icon: tags, avatar initials, the Public marker. Dark is the sona's iris; light is its deep iris ring. Also the plugin frame: its dashed border and its label.

tokens.name: color-secondary-iris-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `color-secondary-iris` text: tag and avatar fills. Never a large fill.

tokens.name: color-secondary-crown
tokens.usage: Zuri's crown amber, as text or icon: tags, avatars, the Listed marker.

tokens.name: color-secondary-crown-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `color-secondary-crown` text.

tokens.name: color-secondary-rose
tokens.usage: Zuri's nose rose, as text or icon: tags, avatars, the Private marker.

tokens.name: color-secondary-rose-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `color-secondary-rose` text.

tokens.name: color-secondary-taupe
tokens.usage: Zuri's warm taupe, as text or icon: tags and avatars. Dark is the sona's exact taupe.

tokens.name: color-secondary-taupe-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `color-secondary-taupe` text.

tokens.name: color-status-neutral
tokens.usage: Stages with nothing moving: Draft, Requested, Paused, Closed; and quiet facts like "Deadline passed". Text on `color-status-neutral-soft` and the surfaces.

tokens.name: color-status-neutral-soft
tokens.usage: StatusPill fill for neutral stages.

tokens.name: color-status-progress
tokens.usage: Work is moving: Accepted, In progress. A calm periwinkle, kept apart from the accent gold.

tokens.name: color-status-progress-soft
tokens.usage: StatusPill fill for moving stages.

tokens.name: color-status-waiting
tokens.usage: Someone else's turn: "Waiting on client", "Waiting on artist". A sand tone, deliberately unalarming.

tokens.name: color-status-waiting-soft
tokens.usage: StatusPill fill for the waiting segment.

tokens.name: color-status-done
tokens.usage: Finished: Delivered, Complete. Sage, never a celebratory bright green.

tokens.name: color-status-done-soft
tokens.usage: StatusPill and success Toast fill.

tokens.name: color-visibility-private
tokens.usage: Private marker: rose with an eye-off icon and the word "Private". Never a lock: the lock only means locked.

tokens.name: color-visibility-private-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Private marker chip.

tokens.name: color-visibility-listed
tokens.usage: Listed marker: amber with a list icon and the word "Listed".

tokens.name: color-visibility-listed-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Listed marker chip.

tokens.name: color-visibility-public
tokens.usage: Public marker: iris blue with a globe icon and the word "Public".

tokens.name: color-visibility-public-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Public marker chip.

tokens.name: color-pin
tokens.usage: Pin fill on artwork.

tokens.name: color-on-pin
tokens.usage: Pin number.

tokens.name: color-pin-ring
tokens.usage: Inner 2px ring of a Pin, the same in both themes, so the pin holds on light art.

tokens.name: color-pin-halo
tokens.usage: Outer 2px halo of a Pin, the same in both themes, so the pin holds on dark art.

tokens.name: color-backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind the phone tree drawer, and behind a modal Dialog.

tokens.name: color-veil
tokens.usage: Neutral wash over blurred mature art, under the MatureCover panel.

tokens.name: color-skeleton
tokens.usage: Skeleton placeholder fill: the hover step in dark, the hairline in light (the hover step is too faint on white).

styles.name: body-long

spacing.note: 4px base. Dense but readable: rows at 28px, controls at 32px.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: Focus ring offset, icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in dense rows; between a pill's icon and word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; tree row horizontal padding; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and pane padding; between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside an item.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between major groups; EmptyState padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Open-item gutters on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: EmptyState vertical breathing room.

tokens.name: space-desk
tokens.usage: The desk showing around the sheet: between it and the screen's edges, the rail, and on phones the header and tab bar.

tokens.name: space-peek-offset-dark
tokens.usage: How far each peek shows below the one above it, per step, in dark.

tokens.name: space-peek-offset-light
tokens.usage: The same in light: peeks sit closer there.

tokens.name: space-peek-inset
tokens.usage: How far each peek is drawn in from both sides, per step, so a pile narrows as it goes down.

tokens.name: space-rise
tokens.usage: How far a placed button, a row, a tab or a quiet button rises when it lifts; applied upward as `calc(-1 * var(--space-rise))`. 0 under Still and reduced motion.

tokens.name: space-sink
tokens.usage: How far a placed or quiet button sinks when pressed. 0 under Still and reduced motion.

radius.note: Soft and friendly. Only pills are fully round: status pills, avatars, toggles, pins, chips, the pill switch, the Fab.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, skeleton lines, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Placed buttons, inputs, selects, badges.

tokens.name: radius-pick
tokens.usage: A pick's corners: a tree row or list row, resting on its list's piece or lifted off it; quiet and plain icon buttons too. Tabs are pills (`radius-full`).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Toasts, menus, the path bar.

tokens.name: radius-object
tokens.usage: An object's corners: Card, tiles, invites, a link, a dense list's piece (tree, list).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, artwork frames, MatureCover, a collection's pile.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: The sheet's corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: StatusPill, VisibilityMarker chip, Avatar, Toggle, Pin, the pill switch (Tabs) and its options, chips, the Fab and a HoldButton. Nothing else.

shadow.note: Paper: the sheet rests on the desk, notes lie on the sheet, art and buttons rest and lift, all with real shadows in both skins; dark is deeper and its top edges catch a warm light, light is papyrus with soft warm-brown shadows and a faint warm ring. Inside a sheet or a note, ink is flat; anything interactable sits on top with a hint of shadow.

tokens.name: elevation-0
tokens.usage: Flat: ink on the nearest page: panes, resting rows, groups, labels, inline content. Anything interactable sits on top (`elevation-art`).

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Older boards' Card. New work, the bundle's Card included, sits on top on `elevation-art`.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Zurfur's card on someone else's page (the bsky.app extension), outside the paper layer. Older canvas boards still name it; new work uses the paper shadows.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Older canvas boards' dialogs. New work, the bundle's Dialog included, uses `elevation-note`.

tokens.name: elevation-sheet
tokens.usage: The sheet resting on the desk.

tokens.name: elevation-note
tokens.usage: A note lying on the sheet: the drawer, a dialog, a menu, a toast, the plugins panel. Dark has real shadows here, so a note needs no border.

tokens.name: elevation-lift
tokens.usage: A note in the air, while it is put down (it settles to `elevation-note`) or picked up.

tokens.name: elevation-art
tokens.usage: Small things on top of the page: Card, list pieces, fields, lifted rows, the pill switch and its lifted option, quiet buttons, art and thumbs, stickers, a Pile's top, tooltips.

tokens.name: elevation-art-hover
tokens.usage: Art or an object lifted 2px under the pointer (`duration-spring`, `easing-spring`); a hopping object's shadow rises to it at each hop (`paperhop`). Under Still and reduced motion the rise stops, but the deeper shadow still shows on hover.

tokens.name: elevation-button
tokens.usage: A button placed on the sheet, a small piece laid on it: every Button but quiet (quiet ones rest as ink, lift on `elevation-art` and keep this one while pressed), a secondary IconButton, a hand-drawn button (`.placed`). A hint, never more. Dark: its top line is `color-text` at 8%, written out.

tokens.name: elevation-button-hover
tokens.usage: A placed button lifted `space-rise` under the pointer. Under Still and reduced motion the rise stops, but this shadow still shows on hover.

tokens.name: elevation-button-press
tokens.usage: A placed button pressed flat onto the sheet, down `space-sink` (dark: its top line `color-text` at 4%). The empty layers keep the change smooth.

tokens.name: elevation-peek
tokens.usage: Each peek under a Pile's top (dark: its top line is `color-text` at 10%, written out).

tokens.name: elevation-edge
tokens.usage: The sheet's own edge: a warm top highlight in dark (`#efd9a8` at 9%, written out), a faint warm ring in light. Already inside `elevation-sheet` (and `elevation-art` in dark); alone only to build a new paper shadow.

tokens.name: elevation-note-edge
tokens.usage: A note's edge, a touch brighter than the sheet's (dark: `#efd9a8` at 13%, written out). Already inside `elevation-note` and `elevation-lift`.

duration.note: Things answer a touch fast and land with a spring. Under the Motion switch's "Still" or prefers-reduced-motion every duration becomes 0ms and nothing moves on its own; reduced motion keeps only `duration-page-fade`.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Colour changes on hover and focus. The press itself is duration-spring.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: A tree expanding, a tab indicator moving, a toggle.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: A note picked up and taken away (`paperlift`), and the desk clearing after it (`deskclear`), with `easing-exit`.

tokens.name: duration-slide
tokens.usage: A drawer put down from the edge (`paperin`). With `easing-slide` when its surface runs past the edge (the one drawer); the phone tree drawer can't, so it lands on `easing-standard`.

tokens.name: duration-note-pop
tokens.usage: A note put down in place: a dialog, a menu, a popover (`paperpop`). With `easing-slide`.

tokens.name: duration-note-up
tokens.usage: A note put down from below: a toast (`paperup`). With `easing-slide`.

tokens.name: duration-page-in
tokens.usage: Going forward, or a board opening: the next page laid down from the side, overshooting a little and settling (`pagein`). With `easing-page`.

tokens.name: duration-page-under
tokens.usage: Going back: the page under settling into place as the top page goes (`pageunder`). With `easing-standard`.

tokens.name: duration-page-out
tokens.usage: Going back, or switching section: the top page lifted and slid fully off (`pageout`). With `easing-exit`.

tokens.name: duration-page-fade
tokens.usage: Pages under reduced motion: they fade, linear, instead of moving (`pagefade`). Under Still they swap at once.

tokens.name: duration-dim
tokens.usage: The desk dimming under a drawer or dialog (`deskdim`), on `easing-standard`. It clears on `duration-slow`.

tokens.name: duration-toast-life
tokens.usage: A toast's whole life, put down to picked up (`paperlife`). Errors stay until dismissed.

tokens.name: duration-status-life
tokens.usage: A small status note's whole life when it isn't a Toast (`paperlife-self`).

tokens.name: duration-spring
tokens.usage: A press squishing and springing back, a hover lift, a twisty turning. Always with easing-spring.

tokens.name: duration-hello
tokens.usage: Something arriving and saying hello: a card popping in, a celebration toast, a stamp landing.

tokens.name: duration-burst
tokens.usage: A celebration's confetti burst, start to fade.

tokens.name: duration-hop
tokens.usage: One cycle of an unopened ping hopping (a short hop, then rest). It stops once the ping is opened.

tokens.name: duration-hold
tokens.usage: A press-and-hold (HoldButton): how long it is held before it fires, growing toward you on `easing-standard`; under Still and reduced motion a fill runs along its foot instead, linear.

tokens.name: easing-spring
tokens.usage: Anything answering a person or saying hello: presses, hovers, arrivals, hops, stamps. Overshoots a little and settles, Nintendo-style.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Layout changing in place: a tree expanding, a list opening up, a tab indicator moving. No overshoot.

tokens.name: easing-slide
tokens.usage: The one drawer sliding in: a small Steam Deck overshoot, then it settles. Its surface runs past the screen's edge, so the overshoot never shows a gap. Trees and lists stay on easing-standard.

tokens.name: easing-page
tokens.usage: A page laid down (`pagein`): a little less overshoot than the drawer, then it settles.

tokens.name: easing-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving.

tokens.name: blur-mature
tokens.usage: MatureCover blur: enough that the art reads as colour, not shapes.

tokens.name: layer-drawer
tokens.usage: The one drawer (Pings, Page configs, Settings, Help & keys), the phone tree drawer and their backdrop.

tokens.name: layer-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog and its backdrop.

tokens.name: layer-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.

sound.note: UI blips: short triangle waves, about 160ms, quiet (peak gain 0.18), notes 90ms apart. On by default with an always-visible Sound switch; never a loop, never for an error.

tokens.name: sound-open
tokens.usage: Opening a ping, a tile or a drawer item.

tokens.name: sound-toggle
tokens.usage: A switch flipping; also plays when Sound is turned back on.

tokens.name: sound-motion
tokens.usage: The Motion switch.

tokens.name: sound-close
tokens.usage: Closing a drawer or a sheet, turning something down politely (Not with Mox).

tokens.name: sound-no
tokens.usage: Mark as spam, remove, block: a low, soft note, never a buzzer.

tokens.name: sound-yes
tokens.usage: A yes that matters to someone else: Yes, go ahead.

tokens.name: sound-celebrate
tokens.usage: Something good just happened (C-E-G): a WIP approved, a comm delivered, an ask opened. Plays with the confetti burst.

tokens.name: sound-ready
tokens.usage: The Den finished waking up (the boot screen).
